# Bronze nails

Type: Material | Internal ID: BronzeNails | Source: Forge | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Bronze x1

# Introduction

Bronze nails are crafted at a Forge with a single Bronze ingot which yields 20x nails each.
Unlike Copper ore, Tin ore, or the smelted metals which are used for Bronze, the nails can be brought through a Portal.

### Building

• Barber station
• T.W.I.G.
• Cart
• Item stand (horizontal)
• Item stand (vertical)
• Karve
• Trap
• Wood shutter
